sessionIntegrityAndInvalidationRules.minorGaps: Gaps < 15 minutes logged in session ledger; signals evaluated strictly on available preceding candles.
sessionIntegrityAndInvalidationRules.criticalGaps: Cumulative gap > 15 minutes OR >30% missing candles marks session INVALID_INCOMPLETE.
sessionIntegrityAndInvalidationRules.signalWindowGaps: Gaps occurring during potential signal confirmation windows cause signal to be SKIPPED.
sessionIntegrityAndInvalidationRules.contextSwitches: Symbol/timeframe changes during RTH invalidate session for that calendar date (INVALID_CONTEXT_SWITCH).
